paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores. The x-axis represents polarity scores, with a linear scale ranging from -1.0 to 0.6, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents counts, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50,000, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 10,000. The plot features a single blue line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 1,000 counts at a polarity score of -1.0, remains relatively stable until -0.6, then gradually increases to around 5,000 counts at -0.2, before sharply rising to a peak of approximately 48,000 counts at 0.0. The line then declines to around 20,000 counts at 0.2, followed by a drop to around 10,000 counts at 0.4, and finally ends at approximately 2,000 counts at 0.6.
